disposition: A calibration failure is inconclusive, not evidence of an admitted candidate gain. No subset, retry, old-study rescue or deadline inference.
scope: 48kHz/64-frame held-eight-voice real-VST3 average thread CPU only

bootstrap.constant_columns: exact constant mean/interval; all-constant group skips identical resamples
bootstrap.rng: SHA256(seed + slash + group_key + slash + decimal_counter), big-endian256-bit integer, reject >=2^256-(2^256 mod n), then mod n; one draw per sampled block index
bootstrap.unit: one complete four-treatment block, all five contrasts resampled jointly

statistical_plan.correlation_limit: set-t allows within-set correlation; six-set independence and t approximation are not guarantees against arbitrary whole-VM temporal correlation
statistical_plan.estimator: equal-weight mean of complete block log contrasts
statistical_plan.gate_numeric_precision: round transformed percentage or percentage-point difference to12 decimal places before comparison
statistical_plan.outcome: unnormalized sum of actual process() thread-CPU nanoseconds; all arms use512-callback baseline denominator
statistical_plan.policy: all96 chronological processes and24 complete blocks required; all gates AND; no exclusion, retries, replacement, subset admission or post-outcome rule changes
statistical_plan.scope: 48kHz/64-frame held-eight-voice real-VST3 average thread CPU only

set_sensitivity.gates: main placebo, extra and all three candidate comparisons must pass BOTH block-bootstrap and set-t intervals
set_sensitivity.leave_one_set: all six omission point estimates reported descriptively; never select an omission
set_sensitivity.unit: six complete four-block Williams-set mean log contrasts
